summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I'd do (investigation phase — no code changes):**  1. **Confirm the symptom is reproducible in the current codebase before touching anything.** I had a sub-agent trace the entire chain — client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist` session middleware → DB — and every link checked out correct:    - Client fetches use `credentials: "include"` so the session cookie is always sent; there's no localStorage/guest-id fallback anywhere in the client.    - The watchlist router has its own session-auth middleware
